settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
The O’Donnell Moonshine Shot Advent Calendar doesn’t just count down the days until Christmas – it makes each one special. With 24 mini jars containing 13 different moonshine liqueur varieties, you’ll enjoy a journey full of surprises, flavour and true O’Donnell spirit. From timeless classics to exciting new creations – perfect for tasting your way through our range day by day and discovering your new favourite liqueur.

The Early Bird deal cannot be combined with other discount codes.

settings.heading: Shipping
settings.content:
£3.95 for orders < 2kg
£5.95 for orders > 2kg

Free shipping for orders over £70!

Shipping cost to Northern Ireland is set at £16.95

settings.heading: Ingredients & Allergens
settings.content: This year’s mini calendar contains no allergens.

settings.heading: Contents - *SPOILER ALERT*
settings.content:
Attention – continue reading only if you really want to know what’s waiting for you in the new Shot Advent Calendar!

Contents:

  • 3× Tough Nut (20 ml / 25% vol)
  • 2× Juicy Cherry (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Wild Berry (20 ml / 25% vol)
  • 2× Toffee (20 ml / 25% vol)
  • 2× Cookie (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Roasted Apple (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Peach (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Passionfruit (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Lime (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Pomegranate (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Strawberry-Rhubarb (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 2× Coffee (20 ml / 20% vol)
  • 1× Exclusive Xmas Edition (20 ml / 20% vol)

    With natural colouring: beta-carotene (E160e)

settings.heading: Rabattcode-Hinweise
settings.content: Der Adventskalender ist nicht mit anderen Rabattcodes kombinierbar, du hast als Gang-Mitglied aber die Möglichkeit deine Proof im Warenkorb gegen einen Wertgutschein einzulösen, welchen du beim Kauf des Kalenders einlösen kannst.

settings.text: Look forward to new flavour highlights every day: from classics like Tough Nut and Roasted Apple to fruity varieties such as Peach, Pomegranate and Strawberry-Rhubarb. 24 minis of 20 ml each – the perfect mix for a varied December.

settings.text: Whether for yourself, as a surprise for friends, or as an original gift, this calendar delivers 24 days full of joy and indulgence. High-quality, eye-catching in design, yet affordably priced – a gift that leaves a lasting impression.

settings.heading: O’Donnell Moonshine – More than just a liqueur

settings.text: Inspired by the original moonshine of the Prohibition era, O’Donnell has been bringing spirits with character into the glass since 2014. Fruity, nutty, or creamy – our liqueurs and spirits in the iconic Mason Jar stand for uncompromising flavour and creative recipes.
